next_cursor.source: Question Truth reviewer packet; Explanation mapping_decision may be used only as hidden mechanical backlog eligibility

resume_policy.default: Build an anti-anchored review packet for APPROVED questions selected by the hidden NEEDS_CHAT_MAPPING_REVIEW backlog hint and excluding existing REVIEWED relations. Reviewer sees Question Truth first, independently solves it, then inspects the exact Current Knowledge owner. Old Explanation semantics and prior targets stay withheld until an optional post-provisional conflict check.
resume_policy.explicit_rereview: An explicit question_id may reopen a former NO_SAFE_MATCH or audit an existing relation. The reviewer must independently solve Question Truth before consulting old Explanation or prior mapping targets.
review_order: independent solve / provisional exam target, decision axis, and minimal answer logic
record concise independent mapping basis in review evidence

independent_analysis.exam_target: what exact knowledge or decision the question tests
independent_analysis.decision_axis: smallest decisive variable, distinction, or boundary
independent_analysis.answer_logic: minimal reasoning from Question Truth to official answer
independent_analysis.distractor_boundary: only when it changes mapping or exposes an adjacent concept
independent_analysis.mapping_fit: why the chosen KP is the smallest sufficient Current owner
independent_analysis.uncertainty: fail closed if Current Knowledge cannot safely own the tested detail

notes: Final 2017 tail pass added only the last clearly exact-owner row found in the bounded scan.
2017 is no longer a linear review frontier. Remaining unmapped questions are intentionally left for evidence-driven reopening only.

Known remainder classes include humanities without an accepted owner, cross-system composite questions, overlay-only knowledge, Source gaps/conflicts, and questions whose Current Knowledge does not fully own every correct option.

history_policy: Historical progress evidence belongs to Git history or audit evidence and MUST NOT participate in Current semantic truth.
